verdicts.title: On operator algebras associated with monomial ideals in noncommuting variables
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We study operator algebras arising from monomial ideals in the ring of polynomials in noncommuting variables, through the apparatus of subproduct systems and C*-correspondences.
We provide a full comparison amongst the related operator algebras. For our analysis we isolate a partially defined dynamical system, to which we refer as the {\em quantised dynamics} of the monomial ideal.

In addition we revisit several previously considered constructions. These include Matsumoto's subshift C*-algebras
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses operator algebras associated with monomial ideals in noncommuting variables, but does not mention Boolean functions, XOR functions, or communication complexity, which are central to the conjecture.
